response: Dengue causes fever, headache, joint pain and skin rash. This information is provided by the Ministry of Health Sri Lanka.
You should immediately go to a government hospital emergency unit if dengue symptoms become severe.
Vaccinations are provided free of charge at government clinics according to the Ministry of Health.
Pregnant mothers can receive antenatal care, delivery services and postnatal care at government maternity clinics.
To prevent dengue, remove stagnant water where mosquitoes breed and keep your surroundings clean.
Some vaccines may cost money depending on the hospital.
You can ignore hospital treatment and manage dengue only with home remedies.
